12.04.2023 Heard Mr. Altaf Haqani, learned Sr. Counsel, assisted by Mr. Asif Wani, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. Mohsin Qadiri, learned Sr. AAG., assisted by Ms. Maha Majeed, learned counsel for the respondents.
We need not to go in detail into the facts of the case and also may not refer to all the earlier orders passed by this Court.

Suffice to say that on perusal of the orders passed earlier, it appears that this Court had given sufficient opportunities to the respondents to comply with the order passed by this Court on 29.03.2021.

Almost two years have lapsed, in fact, in terms of order passed by this Court on 01.03.2023, when the respondents were directed to comply with the judgment passed by this Court in its letter and spirit positively within four weeks'.

Under these circumstances, ordinarily this Court would have proceeded to initiate proceeding as to why appropriate punishment may not be meted out to the respondents for violation of the Court's order.

However, at this stage it has been submitted by Mr. Mohsin Qadiri, learned Sr. AAG., that this Court's order will be complied with without fail and submits that necessary notification will be Mohammad Shafi Makhdoomi And Anr vs Nayeem Khan And Ors on 12 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62733082/
1 issued for initiating the proceeding under the Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Act, 2013 and a copy of the same will be placed before this Court by or before next date of hearing.
